excluded_intermediate_who_target.reason: TULIP v2 requires exactly four documented normalization anchors.

extent.aggregation: World Bank source-native population-weighted global mean exposure

transformations.formula: Use the World Bank WLD observation directly; do not manually average or sum country rows.
Piecewise-linearly map 5, 15, 25 and 35 micrograms per cubic metre to normalized 0, 0.33, 0.67 and 1 using WHO 2021 annual PM2.5 AQG and interim targets.
Subtract the preceding complete-year World exposure from the latest complete year and normalize the increase through the prior annual-change median, p75, p90 and p97.5 distribution.
Assign full extent because the source observation is the World population-weighted aggregate for the metric contract.

receipts.uncertainty: The indicator is a model-based population-exposure estimate informed by satellite retrievals, chemical transport models and monitoring data rather than a direct worldwide instrument average. Exposure surfaces, population weights, calibration, source revisions and the GBD estimation framework affect comparisons. WHO thresholds are health-based guidance rather than legal exceedance limits, and the latest exposure year trails the source update date.
